_comment: Program allowlist for resident-run. Deployment config, not image content — mount or inject it. Each entry grants ONLY the capabilities it declares; AILANG denies the rest. Keep this list short and specific: it is the whole write boundary.

fmt-check.description: Format-check the workspace. Reads and writes inside AILANG_FS_SANDBOX only.

summarise.description: Summarise a document. No FS: it takes its input on stdin, so it cannot read the corpus at will.
